. . . [Barnacle](/periodical/89) article rather in the style of the Spring of the poets, and we wanted you to laugh with us. I think you know the [Gatty](/person/549)s, so I conclude you do not want an autograph from that quarter.
I am glad [Dr Harris](/person/629) was able to go to [George](/person/625)’s wedding, but I shall be glad to hear that he is safe back again[^1] Poor Hursley has been very forlorn all the winter but its [squire](/person/669) came back last week, and its [Vicar](/person/798) comes on the 10th

yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: The Rev. Joseph Hemington Harris (1799/1800-1881), Vicar of Tor Mohun, Torquay, was married to Jane Yonge, sister of the Rev. John Yonge of Puslinch. His son the Rev. George Collyer Harris (1833-1874) married Percy Primrose in London in 1865 (June 1865).
